items.objective: Evaluate a distinct single-kernel alternative: reset output in the default stream, stream input once, reduce locally per CTA, then atomicAdd one CTA result to output. Explore keeping CTA atomic count modest; do not rely on scratch initialization or omit the per-call reset. Compare total time including reset and launch overhead against hierarchical candidates, and validate every required size and the FP64 tolerance.
